page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.16xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by AWS Graviton ARM64 processors. It features 64 dedicated physical cores running at 3.3 GHz with a single thread per core, operating on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server includes 3800 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage, which is bundled directly with the hardware configuration. It delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 34 Gbps. The instance does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The ARM64 architecture and dedicated core allocation offer high resource density and power efficiency typical of the Graviton processor family. This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require fast local storage access, such as large-scale databases, in-memory caches, and data analytics pipelines.
